53.title: Purposes for which health data can be processed for secondary use
53.summary: Health data may be reused only for listed purposes: public health, policy-making, official statistics, education, scientific research (including training and testing AI), and improving care. Purposes (a) to (c) are reserved for public-sector bodies (Art. 53(2)).
53.quote: scientific research related to health or care sectors that contributes to public health

54.title: Prohibited secondary use
54.summary: Health data may never be used for decisions that harm people, for insurance or credit exclusion or pricing, for advertising or marketing, for developing harmful products such as tobacco, alcohol or weapons, or for anything conflicting with national ethics law.
54.quote: carrying out advertising or marketing activities

66.title: Data minimisation and purpose limitation
66.summary: Only data that is adequate, relevant and necessary may be provided. Anonymised data is the default; pseudonymised data only if the purpose cannot be achieved with anonymised data.
66.quote: adequate, relevant and limited to what is necessary

67.title: Health data access applications
67.summary: Applicants who need record-level data submit a data access application describing purpose, data, safeguards and why pseudonymised data is needed.

68.title: Data permits
68.summary: The access body issues a data permit if the purpose, necessity, legal basis, expertise and safeguards are in order. The permit names the data, the people, the duration and the secure environment.

69.title: Health data requests
69.summary: Applicants who only need statistics submit a health data request and receive answers only in an anonymised statistical format, without access to the underlying data.
69.quote: only in an anonymised statistical format

71.title: Right to opt out
71.summary: People can opt out of the reuse of their health data at any time, without giving a reason. Their data is excluded from every answer.
71.quote: at any time, and without providing any reason

73.title: Secure processing environment
73.summary: Record-level data is only processed inside a secure environment: access only for permitted persons, no copying or removal, logs kept, and only anonymised results may be downloaded after review.
73.quote: minimise the risk of the unauthorised reading, copying, modification or removal
